name: Blender addons for Daz Studio character animation

mentions.name: Blender addons for Daz Studio character animation
mentions.description: A collection of Blender addons for animating Daz Studio character assets in Blender and bringing the animation back into Daz Studio. Includes an addon for uncluttering the 3D viewport, with a long-term goal of a zero-effort pipeline to get Daz Studio characters into Unreal or Godot with FACS morphs, JCMs, etc. already set up.
mentions.problem: Animating Daz Studio character assets in Blender and transferring them to game engines like Unreal or Godot with FACS morphs and JCMs set up currently requires significant manual effort.
mentions.audience: 3D character animators working with Daz Studio, Blender, and game engines
mentions.source_excerpt:
A blender addon for uncluttering the viewport: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k91LbFFcMVY

It is a smaller part of a whole collection of addons I've been working on meant for helping with animating character assets from Daz Studio in Blender and then bringing the animation back into Daz Studio.

Eventually I want to have a zero effort way to get characters from Daz Studio into Unreal or Godot with FACS morphs, JCMs, etc. already setup.
